memory_line: Asystole (FLAT): nothing to reset. Push, don't shock.
caption_lesson:
✅ First, normal sinus rhythm
• The SA (sinoatrial) node fires, the wave spreads, the heart squeezes

➖ Then asystole (FLAT)
1️⃣ No signal starts anywhere. The heart sits still
2️⃣ The strip goes flat: no P waves, no QRS, no T waves
3️⃣ It's cardiac arrest. No pulse

⚡ Why a shock won't help
• A shock stops CHAOTIC electricity, like ventricular fibrillation (QUIVER), so the SA node can lead again
• Asystole has no electricity to stop. A shock only steals time from CPR (cardiopulmonary resuscitation)

🔍 Make sure it's real
• Not responding, no pulse in 10 seconds
• Leads still on? Check a second lead. A loose lead or a fine quiver can look flat

✅ What to do
• CPR right away
• Epinephrine as soon as possible, then every 3 to 5 minutes, as ordered
• Find the cause: the Hs and Ts

🧠 Asystole (FLAT): nothing to reset. Push, don't shock.

🔖 Save this for your ECG exam
